algorithm: RECAP: advantage-conditioned policy extraction on a flow-matching VLA, using a distributional value function (cross-entropy over 201 discretized return bins) to compute an N-step advantage and a binarized improvement indicator, with classifier-free-guidance-style advantage-conditioning dropout (30%)
arm: static bimanual system with two 6-DoF arms with parallel-jaw grippers (Fig. 5); plus a factory box-assembly rig and a commercial espresso-machine setup
success_criterion: Per-task, time-limited: laundry "fold[ed] and stacked in the top right corner of the table within 200 seconds"; box assembly "in under 600 seconds"; cafe "all steps within 200 seconds without critical mistakes".
headline_metric: success rate (human-rated episode success labels) and throughput (successful task executions per hour)
headline_value: 'On all of the tasks except diverse laundry, the success rate of the final pi0*.6 model is in the 90%+ range' (§VI-C.1); box assembly ~90% success within the 600s limit; T-shirt/shorts folding shows an overall 50% throughput improvement and box assembly a 2x throughput improvement over 2 RECAP iterations (§VI-C.2); failure-mode-removal ablation reaches 97% success after 2 iterations (§VI-C.4, Fig. 12)
human_data: human correction/intervention episodes collected during autonomous rollouts, task-specific counts (e.g. diverse laundry: 287 correction episodes; box assembly: 360 correction episodes per iteration; cafe: 429 correction episodes), Appendix F
paper_code_mismatch: The general openpi framework (pi0/pi0.5/FAST, flow-matching action head, ALOHA/DROID/LIBERO adapters) is released at commit 215abfb2, but the RECAP-specific pieces described in the paper -- the advantage-conditioning input, the distributional value function, the RECAP training loop (Algorithm 1), and the espresso/laundry/box-assembly checkpoints and datasets -- are not present in the parsed repo.
note_gaps: Exact action-chunk horizon H is not stated numerically anywhere in the parsed paper or code text; headline numbers are chart-only (Figs. 7-10) beyond the specific prose percentages quoted above; no single total model parameter count is given (only the 860M action-expert and 670M value-function-backbone component sizes).
backbone: Gemma 3 4B (pi0.6 VLM backbone); the value function uses the same architecture with a smaller 670M-parameter VLM backbone also initialized from Gemma 3
action_head: flow-matching action expert (860M parameters) attending to the rest of the model's activations, trained jointly with a discretized FAST-tokenizer prediction under the Knowledge Insulation recipe (stop-gradient so the flow-matching expert does not affect the rest of the model)
pretrain_data: 'tens of thousands of hours of demonstrations from numerous tasks and a variety of different robots' (§IV, robots not itemized); the released openpi base checkpoints are separately stated to be pre-trained on '10k+ hours of robot data'
dexterous_evidence: "For the iterative improvement experiments, we use a static bimanual system with two 6 DoF arms with parallel jaw grippers." (Fig. 5 caption, §VI setup)
